title: Western mathematicians fear AI makes them dumber while China builds an entire alliance for it
text:
While 25 Fields Medal winners in the West warn against AI-generated proofs and parts of the community call for a boycott, China is going on the offensive. Fields Medal winner Shing-Tung Yau has launched an alliance of eight institutions and over 1,000 scientists to push AI into math research.
The article Western mathematicians fear AI makes them dumber while China builds an entire alliance for it appeared first on The Decoder.
